🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No water quality classification without verified monitoring data from Environment Agency approved methods and accredited laboratories
  • ❌ No sewage overflow event unreported — all CSO and storm overflow events must be monitored, recorded, and publicly disclosed within 1 hour
  • ❌ No water company environmental performance assessment without Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions integration and ecological impact evidence
  • ❌ No WFD exemption granted without documented proportionate assessment, alternative measures evaluation, and time-bound remediation plan
  • ❌ No pollution source attribution without forensic evidence chain, sampling protocol compliance, and contamination pathway verification
  • ❌ No drinking water quality standard relaxed without Chief Medical Officer approval, risk assessment documentation, and public notification

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map water quality monitoring maturity. Assess river health baselines. Benchmark WFD compliance. Identify pollution and infrastructure gaps.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against water quality use cases. Configure monitoring and compliance protocols. Establish regulatory governance.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across 3 river catchments. Measure water quality improvement and compliance rates. Collect EA officer and water company feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all river basin districts. Integrate with EA monitoring platforms. Deploy across the DEFRA water ecosystem.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade water quality governance reporting. River health transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Compliance quality metrics.
